PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT 1778889999 — SLO breach detected on /v1/generate streaming (p99 > 1.0s). Auto-escalation to oncall triggered. Pager: @Devon (oncall)
Devon (oncall): acked — looking now. Do we have a customer-impact estimate? :rotating_light:
PagerDuty Bot: ~1200 requests in the last 5m above p95 baseline. Affected regions: eu-west-2 > us-west-2 by request share.
Maria: saw a spike on the router tail heatmap, routing fanout climbs and a small subset of shards shows 5–10x queuing. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 480ms, p99 to ~1.9s.
Oliver: streaming stalls reported by a handful of clients (long polls stuck). Could be KV cache misses + misrouted flows.
Devon (oncall): any recent routing rollout or config push?
Shen: we pushed a routing weight update 45m ago for multi-tenant affinity (policy v2.3). Rollout was gradual but there was a config seed change to prefer local shards for certain hashes.
Lisa: adding telemetry link: https://dash.redwood.internal/infra/slo?svc=router&range=15m
Devon (oncall): seeing increased tail on eu-west-2 specifically. Can someone pull the router logs for 1778889900..1778890000?
OpsBot: pulled logs, attaching sampled lines: 
```
[router-239] 2026-08-10T14:55:12Z INFO route_assign uid=abc123 shard=45 dest=shard-45.euw2 weight=0.8
[router-239] 2026-08-10T14:55:13Z WARN enqueue duration=220ms shard=45 queue_len=23
[router-239] 2026-08-10T14:55:16Z ERROR circuit-breaker fired shard=45 dest=shard-46 egress_fail=1
[lb-12]    2026-08-10T14:55:17Z INFO handoff uid=abc123 chosen=region-euw2 (skewed)
```
Devon (oncall): queue_len 23 on a shard that's not supposed to be hot. Looks like fanout concentrated on shard-45. Is there a hotkey or hash skew?
Maria: heatmap correlates: these requests are coming from a single customer prefix but spread over many keys — suggests misrouting weights collapsed to shard-45.
Oliver: I can repro in staging with the same policy flags — when weight seed rounds to a corner case, the hash-to-shard mapping overweights a small set. Looks like a policy bug in v2.3 where prefer-local interacts poorly with fallback weights.
Devon (oncall): immediate mitigation options?
Shen: two quick options: 1) roll back the v2.3 routing seed (safe but slow), 2) temporarily disable prefer-local flag in the router config, 3) increase eviction & prewarm on shard-45 to absorb. I recommend option 2 -> flip flag to false for eu-west-2 and monitor.
Lisa: customer impact: CC team reports 3 customers opened support tickets, one reporting streaming stall during live demo. Need to mark priority for that one.
Devon (oncall): performing config flip now for eu-west-2 prefer-local=false. Will push a per-region override to avoid global blast.
OpsBot: applying override: 
```
cmd> rctl set router.prefer_local euw2 false --scope region --who=devon
status: queued -> applied
```
Devon (oncall): applied. Rolling averages show p95 down to 210ms within 60s, p99 trending down to 750ms.
Maria: streaming stall count dropped from 48 -> 6 in 5m. Good signal.
Oliver: still seeing a small tail bump — probably eviction + cold KV cache for the warmed-up flows. Recommend warming by issuing targeted requests to shards 45/46 for a few minutes. I'll run a safe probe.
Shen: also flagging a follow-up: revert v2.3 semantics or patch weighting algorithm. Filing an ENG ticket.
Devon (oncall): Pager update to #customers: "We experienced elevated latency in EU-WEST-2 impacting streaming sessions for some customers. We've applied a regional routing override and are seeing recovery. Investigating root cause and will follow up." :white_check_mark: @Customer Success — please triage the high-impact ticket.
Lisa: acknowledging, will reach out to affected customer immediately and offer cleanup and timeline.
Devon (oncall): handing off to Oliver for deeper debug + patch during next oncall overlap. I'm going offline in 20m — leaving incident bridge open.
Oliver: taking over. I'll correlate rollout diffs with routing seed RNG edge cases and draft a hotfix. Creating ENG-INC-7832.
Shen: adding instrumentation task: add percent-of-requests-per-shard gauge and an alert when >5x baseline for >30s.
Devon (oncall): final notes: duration ~30m, regional override applied, partial customer impact (3 tickets, 1 high). Root cause suspected: routing policy v2.3 weight aggregation bug causing fanout collapse to a small shard set under certain seeds. Postmortem owners: Oliver (root cause/fix), Maria (observability), Shen (policy patch), Lisa (customer comms).
PagerDuty Bot: INCIDENT status: mitigated -> monitoring. Next steps: schedule postmortem meeting, assign rollback vs patch decision.
Oliver: will create a draft postmortem and ping stakeholders. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Lisa: I'll log the customer outreach notes and record timeline.
Devon (oncall): thanks team — leaving bridge. @Oliver you're primary until postmortem closed.
Oliver: got it. Closing thread once draft posted. "
